name: SCO Dimension of the Three-Code Class
proof: The established spherical dimension of this class is one.  Theorem 12 of Chornomaz--Moran--Waknine gives $\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)+1\leq\mathrm{SCO}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal H)$.  The directly verified sign-rank value here is two, so the two bounds coincide at $\mathrm{SCO}=2$.
